sentences.en: Vaccines typically take years of painstaking research to develop.
sentences.zh: 疫苗通常需要数年的时间进行细致入微的研究才能开发出来。

sentences.en: Each item was described in painstaking detail.
sentences.zh: 每一件物品都被详细而仔细地描述了。

sentences.en: He completed the project with painstaking effort.
sentences.zh: 他用尽了全力完成了这个项目。

mnemonic: 合成词：pains（痛苦）+taking（花…的）→煞费苦心的
